integrity: All finite checks and their exact arithmetic code are included. Infinite-family statements rest on the analytic proof; relevant literature and mathematical-record comparisons have bibliographic limitations.
scientific_limitations: The theorem uses the canonical zero-sum Euclidean embedding, not optimized Euclidean ellipsoids or weighted Johnson metrics. The full combinatorial structure of the polytope of maximizing centers is not determined. No independent external scientific validation has been conducted.
title: Sharp spread and Euclidean incenter freedom for triangular-graph Lipschitz-free spaces
